promptEs: En La mayor, ¿cómo se cifra el dominante secundario que resuelve en ii?
promptEn: In A major, how is the secondary dominant that resolves to ii labelled?
explanationEs: En La mayor, el dominante de ii es Fa♯7 y se cifra V/ii. Resuelve en Sim (ii): su tercera es la sensible de Sim y sube un semitono.
explanationEn: In A major, the dominant of ii is F♯7 and it is labelled V/ii. It resolves to Bm (ii): its third is the leading tone of Bm and rises a semitone.
